## BF_00_DAILY_ORCHESTRATOR — STAGE 1
Triggers: Daily Schedule (06:00) OR Manual Webhook (POST /bf00-run-task, body.Task_ID).

Flow: normalize context -> read 21/22 + reference sheets -> select+validate today READY tasks
-> HOLD (incomplete) logged / PROCESS -> dedup (Task_ID+Input_Hash) -> DUPLICATE logged / NEW
-> log RUN_STARTED -> build INTERNAL + PUBLIC contexts (compliance gating) -> pass PUBLIC brief to BF_01.

Data boundary before BF_02: BF_01 (research, PASS only) merges with INTERNAL_BRAND_CONTEXT by Task_ID,
then Prepare BF_02 Payload emits ONE structured JSON to BF_02. research_status=HOLD -> HOLD branch.
INTERNAL context (brand/SKU/claims/messages/knowledge) never reaches BF_01. Nothing published.
